entries.title: Change Firstmate's keys
entries.body: Settings → Keyboard lists every command with its keys. Record a new key, remove one, or put it back, and if a key already belongs to another command, Firstmate names it and moves it only when you save. Your keys work everywhere in the window, show on buttons, in ⌘K and in the menu, and stay after a restart. Keyboard Settings… and Reset All Keys… in the app menu are always there.

picture.alt: Keyboard settings recording ⌘L for Show the next card, saying the key already runs Go to the main message and that saving moves it
